topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: Got a call from an artist. Said someone tattooed their work on their skin. World's gone mad, I guess. Told them I'd take a look, but I ain't making promises. Folks do crazy things when they fall for a piece of art, but this takes the cake. This city, you see a lot, but a canvas turned into a walkin' billboard, that's new. Could be a devoted fan, or maybe someone tryin' to make a statement. I've seen harder cases. I'll take a walk, keep my eyes peeled, and see what shakes loose.📚 Noir vibes all the way.
